goal: gad ask: free-text input, RIGID structured output. Operator standing rule 2026-05-08: 'that gad ask is going to have to be very fixed so our slm/llm training isnt doing poorly.' Today gad ask <verb> requires exact subcommand. Replace with: gad ask '<free text>' → parser infers intent, normalizes to canonical action (one of: byok-set, env-set, note-add, todo-add, decision-add, handoff-create, ...) → emits tool_action_json envelope (per slm-learning-120) → executes. Free input UX, deterministic output schema. The parsed (input, action_json) pairs become first-class training data for the tool-action specialist (slm-learning Initiative IV). Acceptance: gad ask --dry-run returns the parsed action without executing; gad ask --json emits the envelope; ambiguous input returns top-3 candidate actions with confidences for operator selection; every invocation logs (input, parsed_action, executed_action, success_bit) to .planning/datasets/ask-traces/<date>.jsonl. Composes with GLOBAL-D-318 (Kael uses SLM router) — gad ask should USE the same router under the hood.
